summary.intent: Take the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge for Soony's launch: analyze the supplier/ERP data, then build and polish an agent product (poller, extraction, recheck-and-act, approvals, phone calls) with a demo and pitch ready for the 12:00 Sunday hand-in.
summary.outcome: Found that the plan said 'ok' while the Collector's Edition misses Sunday (art book overbooking, failed statues, packing speed) and built a working ask-soony app (live and demo instances, UI polish, J/K and Cmd+Enter keys, column mapping, phone-call bridge, demo script). Rehearsed all three demo stories successfully; realtime voice calls were still unreliable and the demo's automatic phone-alert trigger was unresolved.

repo: data/ is gitignored and holds confidential portal data; .env is gitignored, .env.example is committed; never put data values in code.
Portal API only has GET /api/v1/files, /files/{path} and /archive.zip; no webhooks or notifications. Files are replaced under the same name, so poll and compare SHA-256.
Live (ask-soony.stenglein.dev) and demo (ask-soony-demo.stenglein.dev) instances share one alert database; the alert-to-case link is stored per state folder.

Calls default to ASK_CALL_PROVIDER=dry_run; real calls via `CALLS=twilio ASK_CALL_AFTER_MIN=1 scripts/demo.sh reset` or `CALLS=openai`, ~$0.38/min Twilio plus OpenAI Realtime. ASK_CARD_ALERTS=off disables the case-to-phone bridge (set on live).

OpenAI realtime webhook is configured in the OpenAI project and pointed at the live server; it was switched to the demo address for testing, so calls from demo hit the correct instance only after that change.
The web UI polls state every 5 s (POLL_MS = 5000) and routine data every 15 s at app level (App.tsx), so phone decisions show on Today and Launch within 5 s.
The team workflow lives in CLAUDE.md and PROGRESS.md; claim tasks via a 'Now' line in PROGRESS.md. Entire hooks only checkpoint when repo files change.
columns.py maps English/German/SAP column synonyms to canonical fields, with a cached gpt-4.1-mini fallback for unknown headers; the paper check keeps one row per PO line with the newer file winning.

code.finding: New bridge that raises one phone alert for red or soon-due untouched cases (every 30 s, one at a time) and applies phone decisions to the case exactly once.

Twilio to SIP to OpenAI Realtime voice agent; was changed to semantic VAD (low eagerness), no overlapping responses, and up to two reconnects of the sideband after noise caused error loops and a dropped call.
Supports reset, restart (keep state), stop, and CALLS=twilio|openai; reset also clears demo phone alerts.

friction: Portal token was initially empty, blocking data access.
Cloudflare 1033 error on the demo host came from a DNS record briefly pointing to the wrong tunnel.
Safari caches favicons stubbornly; cache-busting version query was needed.
The J/K handler walked folded look-alike cases individually, so the highlight vanished and ordering seemed to jump.
gpt-realtime test call failed: background noise triggered false speech, overlapping responses caused 'conversation already has an active response' errors, and the connection dropped after ~20 s.
Demo's background loop does not raise phone alerts automatically; the call had to be started by hand.
An edit to demo.sh didn't apply as expected, so a restart silently did not happen.
New drop CSVs had differing encodings and rows with extra fields, breaking the CSV reader and verifier until made robust.
open_items: Fix why the demo server's escalation loop never raises phone alerts on its own.
Re-test realtime voice call with the new semantic VAD settings (~$1) or fall back to keypad calls on stage; switch calls off on demo afterwards (`scripts/demo.sh restart` without CALLS).
Several commits remain unpushed on jonas/today-flow; push when asked.
Register sender email addresses in the portal Settings and send the Karton Nowak art-book order for real.
Produce the video and the pitch deck before the 12:00 hand-in.
Optional demo features: replay supplier replies on demo, fold count questions, 'what still saves it' on Launch, top bar for Maren.
Show the mapped-column notes in the data-health UI (needs frontend change); the contract redline PDF was not reviewed.
The earlier Claude doc artifact still exists next to the briefing page; decide whether to delete it.
